cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(LMX_NetSurf_C99 LANGUAGES C)
  set(_netsurf_standalone ON)
else()
  set(_netsurf_standalone OFF)
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
option(LMX_NETSURF_BUILD_TESTS "Build offline document and image checks" ${_netsurf_standalone})
set(LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor" CACHE PATH "Local NetSurf source collection")
set(_ns_generated "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_dom.cmake")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_css.cmake")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_bmp.cmake")

function(lmx_netsurf_library short upstream)
  set(source_root "${LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR}/${upstream}")
  if(upstream STREQUAL "libcss")
    set(source_root "${_ns_css_root}")
  endif()
  file(GLOB_RECURSE sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${source_root}/src/*.c")
  list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/css_property_parser_gen\\.c$")
  if(upstream STREQUAL "libdom")
    set(c99_sources)
    foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
      lmx_netsurf_dom_view("${source}" view)
      list(APPEND c99_sources "${view}")
    endforeach()
    set(sources ${c99_sources})
  endif()

  if(upstream STREQUAL "libnsbmp")
    set(sources "${_ns_bmp_view}")
  endif()
  add_library(lmx_ns_${short} STATIC ${sources})
  add_library(LMX::${short} ALIAS lmx_ns_${short})
  target_include_directories(lmx_ns_${short} PUBLIC "${LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR}/${upstream}/include"
    PRIVATE "${source_root}/src")
  set_target_properties(lmx_ns_${short} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
  if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(lmx_ns_${short} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
  endif()
  if(UNIX)
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_ns_${short} PRIVATE _DEFAULT_SOURCE=1)
  endif()
endfunction()

lmx_netsurf_library(wapcaplet libwapcaplet)
lmx_netsurf_library(parserutils libparserutils)
target_include_directories(lmx_ns_parserutils PRIVATE "${_ns_generated}/libparserutils")
lmx_netsurf_library(hubbub libhubbub)
target_include_directories(lmx_ns_hubbub PRIVATE "${_ns_generated}/libhubbub")
target_link_libraries(lmx_ns_hubbub PUBLIC LMX::parserutils)

lmx_netsurf_library(dom libdom)
target_sources(lmx_ns_dom PRIVATE "${LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR}/libdom/bindings/hubbub/parser.c"
  "${LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR}/libdom/bindings/xml/expat_xmlparser.c")
foreach(binding IN ITEMS hubbub xml)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/dom/bindings/${binding}")
  file(GLOB binding_headers "${LMX_NETSURF_VENDOR_DIR}/libdom/bindings/${binding}/*.h")
  foreach(header IN LISTS binding_headers)
    get_filename_component(name "${header}" NAME)
    configure_file("${header}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/dom/bindings/${binding}/${name}" COPYONLY)
  endforeach()
endforeach()
target_include_directories(lmx_ns_dom PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
if(TARGET LMX::expat)
  set(_ns_expat LMX::expat)
else()
  find_package(EXPAT REQUIRED)
  set(_ns_expat EXPAT::EXPAT)
endif()
target_link_libraries(lmx_ns_dom PUBLIC LMX::hubbub LMX::parserutils LMX::wapcaplet ${_ns_expat})

lmx_netsurf_library(css libcss)
file(GLOB css_generated CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_ns_generated}/libcss/*.c")
target_sources(lmx_ns_css PRIVATE ${css_generated})
target_link_libraries(lmx_ns_css PUBLIC LMX::parserutils LMX::wapcaplet)
lmx_netsurf_library(svgtiny libsvgtiny)
target_include_directories(lmx_ns_svgtiny PRIVATE "${_ns_generated}/libsvgtiny")
target_link_libraries(lmx_ns_svgtiny PUBLIC LMX::dom LMX::wapcaplet)
if(NOT WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_ns_svgtiny PUBLIC m)
endif()
lmx_netsurf_library(nsbmp libnsbmp)
lmx_netsurf_library(nsgif libnsgif)
target_compile_definitions(lmx_ns_nsgif PRIVATE NSGIF_NAME=nsgif NSGIF_VERSION=1.0.0)

add_library(lmx_netsurf_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::netsurf_extra ALIAS lmx_netsurf_extra)
target_link_libraries(lmx_netsurf_extra INTERFACE LMX::wapcaplet LMX::parserutils LMX::hubbub
  LMX::dom LMX::css LMX::svgtiny LMX::nsbmp LMX::nsgif)

if(LMX_NETSURF_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  foreach(test IN ITEMS strings dom_html dom_xml svg images)
    add_executable(lmx_netsurf_${test} "tests/${test}.c")
    target_link_libraries(lmx_netsurf_${test} PRIVATE LMX::netsurf_extra)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
      target_compile_options(lmx_netsurf_${test} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors -UNDEBUG)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME netsurf.${test} COMMAND lmx_netsurf_${test})
  endforeach()
  add_executable(lmx_netsurf_css "tests/css.c")
  target_link_libraries(lmx_netsurf_css PRIVATE LMX::css)
  if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(lmx_netsurf_css PRIVATE -pedantic-errors -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME netsurf.css COMMAND lmx_netsurf_css)
endif()
